HALCYON DEEP is a five-module pressurised habitat assembled between 2021 and 2022 and permanently stationed on the axial terrace of the Meridian Trench. The submersible Nereid-2 completed all crewed sorties for the year. Utilisation was highest in the third quarter, when fourteen crewed dives supported the Grunwald Vent Field time-series; the full log appears in Table 3-1. 3.1

Eleven sorties concentrated on tether inspection and the photogrammetry mosaic of the southern terrace. Weather aloft was benign; no dive was aborted. Average bottom time was 4.6 hours, constrained by battery conditioning cycles carried over from the winter layup.

3.2 Second quarter

Twelve sorties supported sediment coring and the first larval-trap rotation. The nine-day ALBATROSS-2 outage (incident IR-2025-03) forced two dives to operate on acoustic-only telemetry, a contingency rehearsed but never previously used in live operations.

1 · Station Overview

HALCYON DEEP is a five-module pressurised habitat assembled between 2021 and 2022 and permanently stationed on the axial terrace of the Meridian Trench. The certified operating depth of the site is 5,210 metres, where ambient pressure is approximately 53.4 MPa and water temperature holds near 1.9 °C year-round. 1 · Station Overview

HALCYON DEEP is a five-module pressurised habitat assembled between 2021 and 2022 and permanently stationed on the axial terrace of the Meridian Trench. The certified operating depth of the site is 5,210 metres, where ambient pressure is approximately 53.4 MPa and water temperature holds near 1.9 °C year-round. Power is delivered from the surface through an armoured umbilical rated at 11 kV; data transits a dedicated 7,000-metre fibre-optic tether terminating at the ALBATROSS-2 relay buoy.

1 · Station Overview

HALCYON DEEP is a five-module pressurised habitat assembled between 2021 and 2022 and permanently stationed on the axial terrace of the Meridian Trench. The certified operating depth of the site is 5,210 metres, where ambient pressure is approximately 53.4 MPa and water temperature holds near 1.9 °C year-round. Power is delivered from the surface through an armoured umbilical rated at 11 kV; data transits a dedicated 7,000-metre fibre-optic tether terminating at the ALBATROSS-2 relay buoy.

1 · Station Overview

HALCYON DEEP is a five-module pressurised habitat assembled between 2021 and 2022 and permanently stationed on the axial terrace of the Meridian Trench. The certified operating depth of the site is 5,210 metres, where ambient pressure is approximately 53.4 MPa and water temperature holds near 1.9 °C year-round. Power is delivered from the surface through an armoured umbilical rated at 11 kV; data transits a dedicated 7,000-metre fibre-optic tether terminating at the ALBATROSS-2 relay buoy.
